title: 建築設計Ⅰ
subtitle: Architectural Design Studio I
keywords: Architectural Design 2.Spatial Composition and Regional Cooperation 3.Architectural Features 4.Architectural Drafting 5.Presentation of Drafting
educationalGoal: You will be able to learn the design method and drafting for small-scale buildings, and also develop the ability to summarize and present your ideas. First, you need to understand the surrounding environment of the target site set in cooperation with the area. Next, you design your intended architectural space based on the conditions such as the architectural use, function, composition, beauty, and measurable shape of the subject. The basic contents of the design must be represented in draftings and the like.
advice: This learning is the first step in architectural design. The first project is the design of a "cafe" with a single function. The second project is the design of the "house", the most well-known architecture. ○projectI "Cafe": ○projectⅡ “House”: Explanation of project Explanation of project Lecture on related contents Lecture on related contents Esquisse Esquisse Teaching materials: Distribute prints for each project and add explanations.
books: Texts:“Architectural Drafting”Gakugei-pub.co., “Architectural Drafting and Expression Technique”Shokokusha.co., “3rd Collection of Compact Architectural Design Documents” Maruzen-pub.co. Reference Books: “Architectural Works 2019” Kanazawa Institute of Technology, “Residential Building”, “House Special Feature”, “New Architecture”, “Architectural Culture”, “GA”etc[Shinkenchikusha co.etc.] Reserved Books: Not specified
requiredKnowledge: It is important familiar accustomed to architecture. It is important to get the pleasure of creating your own work. Let's go to actually see the new architecture that has been talked about. Habit of reading architecture magazines is important. It is important to always think about architecture. Sketch when you come up with something on a daily basis. It is important to increase opportunities to move your hands. It is important to discuss with fellow each other. It is also important to help senior class architectural drafting.

activityGoals.body: Understand the conditions of use, function, configuration, beauty, etc. required for architectural design.
The design image and concept can be clearly shown. You can design as an integrated architecture.
The basic contents that the architecture and the district should have can be expressed by draftings.
Esquisse steps and assignment submissions can proceed according to the schedule.
As a basis for future architectural design 2, etc., basic design techniques can be acquired.

achievementLevels.ideal: In addition to the basic functions as an architectural space, the theme and ingenuity that bring out charm and comfort are included. Even in drafting expressions including architectural perspectives, presentations that give beauty and impression to viewers have been achieved.
achievementLevels.standard: In addition to satisfying the basic functions of the architectural space, efforts and ideas that lead to charm and comfort are recognized. The drafting expression, including architectural perspectives, has also achieved perfection that is easy for viewers to understand.

lessons.content: 1.Guidance: In addition to satisfying the basic functions of the architectural space, efforts and ideas that lead to charm and comfort are recognized. The drafting expression, including architectural perspectives, has also achieved perfection that is easy for viewers to understand. 2.Explanation of the first project "Cafe": purpose, design conditions, necessary rooms, site conditions, and required drafting 3.Task until next week
lessons.operation: Lectures and Questions Distribution of printed materials (power point)
lessons.assignments: Review: You need to make sure that you have a thorough understanding of the design of the first project, the "cafe". Preparation: Esquisse the house plan for zoning etc. by the next time.

lessons.content: Lecture 1-1: Basic plan of cafe and Examples of works Esquisse Check 1 Task until next week
lessons.operation: Lectures and Questions Distribution of printed materials (power point) Exercises in the drafting room
lessons.assignments: Review: Make sure you understand the cafe's basic plans and examples of works. Preparation: You should consider what teachers pointed out about 1st Esquisse. Then, after correcting it, proceed to the second Esquisse.

lessons.content: Lecture 1-2: Basics of Steel Structure and RC Structure in Architecture Esquisse Check 2 Task until next week
lessons.operation: Lectures and Questions Distribution of printed materials (power point) Exercises in the drafting room
lessons.assignments: Review: Make sure you understand the steel structure and RC structure in architecture. Preparation: You should consider what teachers pointed out about second Esquisse. Then, after correcting it, proceed to the 3rd Esquisse.

lessons.content: Esquisse Check 3 Task until next week
lessons.assignments: Review: Make sure you understand 3rd esquisse. Preparation: Proceed with the 4th esquisse including the architectural form.

lessons.content: Lecture 1-3: Points to keep in mind, such as presentations Esquisse Check 4 Task until next week
lessons.operation: Lectures and Questions Distribution of printed materials (power point) Exercises in the drafting room
lessons.assignments: Review: Make sure you understand the points to keep in mind, such as presentations. Preparation: Review the contents of the teachers regarding the 4th Esquisse. Then, after correcting it, proceed with the final esquisse conscious of the three-dimensional composition.

lessons.content: Final Esquisse Check Task until next week
lessons.assignments: Preliminary lesson: Make sure you understand what the teachers point out in the final Esquisse. Preparation: Produce a work in cluding a drafting presentation.

lessons.content: 1.Submission of the first project drafting 2.Explanation of the second project "House": purpose, design conditions, necessary rooms, site conditions, and required drafting 3.Lectures related to the second project
lessons.operation: Lectures and Questions Distribution of printed materials (power point)
lessons.assignments: Review: Make sure you fully understand the second project, "Housing". Preparation: Esquisse the house plan for zoning etc. by the next time.

lessons.content: 1.Comment of the first project:(Student presentation of excellent works) 2.Submission confirmation, Attendance confirmation, Return of first project drafting
lessons.operation: Reflection in taking lectures No.1 Self-check in taking lectures No.1 Lectures and Questions
lessons.assignments: Review: Make sure you understand the comment of the first project. Preparation: Review and modify Esquisse.

lessons.content: Lecture 2-1: Introduction of house works Esquisse Check 1 Task until next week
lessons.operation: Lectures and Questions Distribution of printed materials (power point) Exercises in the drafting room
lessons.assignments: Review: Make sure you understand house works. Preparation: Esquisse a concrete house plan by the next time.

lessons.content: Lecture 2-2: Three-dimensional design by architectural model Esquisse Check 2 Task until next week
lessons.operation: Lectures and Questions Distribution of printed materials (power point) Exercises in the drafting room
lessons.assignments: Review:Make sure you understand Three-dimensional design. Preparation: By the next time, proceed with the 3rd Esquisse, including the roof design.

lessons.content: Lecture 2-3: Basics of Wooden Structure in Architecture Esquisse Check 3 Task until next week
lessons.operation: Lectures and Questions Distribution of printed materials (power point) Exercises in the drafting room
lessons.assignments: Review: Make sure you understand the basics of wooden structure. Preparation: By the next time, proceed to the 4th Esquisse including the architectural structure.

lessons.content: Lecture 2-4: Drafting presentation Esquisse Check 4 Task until next week
lessons.operation: Lectures and Questions Distribution of printed materials (power point) Exercises in the drafting room
lessons.assignments: Review: Make sure you understand the drafting presentation. Preparation: Review and correct the 4th esquisse pointed out by teachers. Then proceed with the final esquisse while being aware of the three-dimensional composition of the interior and exterior of the house.

lessons.content: Final esquisse check Task until next week
lessons.assignments: Review: Make sure you understand what the teacher points out. Preparation: Create project draftings including presentations.

lessons.content: 1.Submission of the second project drafting 2.Explaining homework for summer vacation Check the completeness of the project drafting
lessons.operation: Lectures and Questions Distribution of printed materials (power point)
lessons.assignments: Review: Learn more about summer vacation homework.

lessons.content: 1.Comment on the second project:(Student presentation of excellent works) 2.Submission confirmation, attendance confirmation, return of the second project drafting
lessons.operation: Reflection in taking lectures No.2 Self-check in taking lectures No.2 Comment of the second project and confirmation of attendance
lessons.assignments: Review: Make sure you understand the comment of the second project.
